performedBy: manual mutation while building packages/contracts. With the file present the gate moved DeadlineRepository's eight guarantees from `unimplemented` to `unproven`, printed all eight with the check each was waiting on, and exited 1. Deleting the placeholder returned it to exit 0. This is the property the layer exists for: an empty file is enough to make a repository 'exist', and existence is what turns a promise into a debt.
